zh:
耶鲁大学（Yale University）成立于1701年，位于美国康涅狄格州纽黑文市，是美国第三古老的高等教育机构，也是常春藤盟校核心成员之一。学校下设14个学院，在校生超13000人，覆盖法学、商学、医学、艺术、人文社科等全领域。
耶鲁大学以人文社科与法学教育闻名全球，其法学院长期稳居世界法学院排名榜首，培养了61位诺贝尔奖得主、5位菲尔兹奖得主、3位图灵奖得主、5位美国总统。学校注重通识教育与精英培养，在文学、历史、经济学、公共政策等领域拥有深厚的学术积淀。2026QS世界大学排名中，耶鲁大学位列世界第21位。
en: Yale University is a private research university in New Haven, Connecticut, United States. Founded in 1701, it is the third-oldest institution of higher education in the United States and a core member of the Ivy League. The University comprises 14 schools, with over 13,000 enrolled students, excelling in law, business, medicine, arts, and humanities and social sciences. Yale Law School is consistently ranked No.1 in the world, and the University has produced 61 Nobel Prize winners, 5 Fields Medalists, 3 Turing Award winners, and 5 U.S. presidents. Ranked No.21 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
